correctness.rationale: Complete 360-element multiplication table and seven conjugacy classes are generated from the parity definition of \(A_6\). Breadth-first subgroup generation enumerates all words in a given pair and its inverses. Commutator closure constructs the full derived subgroup; iteration either reaches the identity or stabilizes at a nontrivial perfect subgroup. Enumerating all 360 possible partners per representative, weighted by class size, is therefore an exhaustive finite proof of the classwise table and the five-bin 129600-pair census. All exact assertions and the independent 30-times-216 \(S_4\) count replayed successfully with included verify.py; no timeout or sample is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Sabatini identifies a specific \(A_6\) obstruction to an otherwise valid normalizer divisibility theorem. Determining all \(A_6\) conjugacy classes precisely resolves the boundary of that natural exception. The exact metabelian versus soluble pair densities and unique \(S_4\) length-three mechanism explain quantitatively why the bounds differ. This is a motivated complete finite classification, not a cherry-picked parameter increment.
